anchorFacts: The Oaks open their inaugural season at home. AJ Dybantsa shines in his rookie debut as the Oaks win their first win as a franchise.

The Oaks open their inaugural season at home vs the San Antonio Spurs and instantly get their first win in franchise history, After 0-9 through rookie camp and preseason the team had grown anxious. Coach Shepard was asked after the game how the locker room responded to the win and he laughed and said his ears were still ringing.

Coach Shepard, who is also celebrating his first win as a rookie head coach, emphasized that it was important to honor the moment for its context but to not get too caught up and the next loss could be a game away. Saying that its important to build on the things that were good and eliminate the bad. The Oaks scored 97 while holding San Antonio to 84. The Oaks next game will be at home while Charolette comes to town.
